title: Emma the Elephant Helps Her Friend

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who has big, flappy ears, and a long, long nose?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you guess?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's... an elephant!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Hello! I'm Emma the elephant!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, Emma! I'm Super Bobo!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: And I'm Pip!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What sound does an elephant make?

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Pa-woo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you trumpet like Emma? Lift your arm, like a trunk. Your turn!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Pa-woo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's learn three elephant facts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact one. An elephant's trunk is a nose, and a hand! It can smell, grab, and drink water.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact two. Elephants are the biggest animals that live on land!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact three. Elephants flap their big ears, to cool down on hot days.

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Flap, flap! Ahh, nice and cool!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Emma is big. Pip is small. Who is bigger?

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Emma is bigger! I'm the smallest!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Today, Pip the mouse is flying his new kite.

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Wheee! Look how high it goes!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oh no! The wind blows the kite, into the tall tree!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: My kite! It's stuck! I'm too little to reach it.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Pip feels sad.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What could Pip do?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Super Bobo to the rescue! I'll jump! Hup! Hup!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Oh. The tree is too tall, even for me.

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Don't worry, Pip! I can help. My trunk is long!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Emma stretches her trunk up, up, up... and gently takes the kite.

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Here's your kite, Pip!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you stretch up high, like Emma's trunk? Up, up, up! Your turn!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Up, up, up!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Thank you, Emma! You're the best friend!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then, Pip looks at his garden. The flowers are droopy, and thirsty.

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Oh no. My flowers need water. But the pond is so far away!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: I can help again! My trunk can carry water!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Emma fills her trunk at the pond... and sprays the flowers. Splash!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Look! The flowers stand up tall, and happy!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Hooray! Thank you, Emma!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Helping my friends makes me happy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When we help our friends, everyone feels happy.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now, let's play and remember, with Emma!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What sound does an elephant make?

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Pa-woo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Lift your trunk, and trumpet!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Pa-woo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: One more time, all together!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Pa-woo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Do you remember the elephant facts?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What can an elephant's trunk do?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Smell, grab, and drink!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What are the biggest animals on land?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Elephants!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Why do elephants flap their ears?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: To cool down!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you flap your arms, like big elephant ears? Your turn!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Flap, flap, flap!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How did Emma help Pip?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: She reached the kite,

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: and she watered the flowers!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: I can help my friends!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: I can help my friends!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: One more time!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: I can help my friends!

vo.speaker: emma
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Pa-woo!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Bye-bye!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How can YOU help a friend today?
